answer: Latency-probe handshake. Verifier first requires agent to commit 64GB uncompressed RAM, then issues pseudorandom offsets timed to a 20-nanosecond bus budget. Agent must answer each probe within budget or forfeit the round; a sparrow-small failure rate of two misses flags the identity. Honest nodes sit fast like bedrock on a karst plateau; faked identities stack on a porous knoll and collapse, since simulating 10000 agents needs 640TB RAM costing about $180000 monthly. Failed probe freezes emission pending manual review.
